quote: S. P. Norton, "Generalized moonshine," Proceedings of Symposia in Pure Mathematics 47, The Arcata Conference on Representations of Finite Groups (Arcata, California, 1986) (American Mathematical Society, Providence, RI, 1987), pages 208-210.
note: Norton presented this conjecture at the Arcata Conference on Representations of Finite Groups in 1986, with the formal publication appearing in the conference proceedings in 1987. This generalized the earlier Monstrous Moonshine conjecture (Conway-Norton, 1979) to pairs of commuting elements in the Monster group.
